messages:
clair (eng-runtime): Noticing a spike in p95 for short streaming requests after yesterday's kernel-selector + batch window changes. p50 steady, p95 up ~3x. Anyone else? :grimacing:

ben (eng-ml): Yup. Reported by a customer and flagged in SLO alerting. Short payloads (<64 tokens) worst hit.

yuri (perf): grabbed a quick CPU+syscall trace on a canary host. Summary: tokenize/parse work increased and there
re many more writev syscalls (small frames).

clair (eng-runtime): numbers from canary A (before -> after):
  p50 20ms -> 22ms
  p90 38ms -> 50ms
  p95 50ms -> 155ms
  p99 110ms -> 330ms

eva (infra): tcpdump/strace confirms many 256-512B frames instead of coalesced 2-4KB writes. That increases syscall overhead and kernel scheduling jitter.

yuri (perf): pprof top (short):
```
32.4%  tokenize_worker
18.1%  writev/syscall
10.7%  kernel_selector::validate_variant
9.9%   kv_cache::lookup
```

ben (eng-ml): kernel_selector validate now hashes more metadata fields (we added quant flags and fp bits). That made the cache key unstable across some builds -> validate path rebuilding tokenizer ctx.

clair (eng-runtime): observed flow: kernel_selector -> validate_variant() -> clear_tokenizer_ctx() -> allocate_tokenizer() -> tokenize. Even when model unchanged, the hash mismatch triggers a rebuild.

yuri (perf): batching window reduction (8ms -> 3ms) also decreased average batch size, increasing per-request kv lookups and L1 cache churn. The two changes amplify each other.

clair (eng-runtime): repro command used:
```
wrk -t6 -c150 -d45s --script=short_stream.lua http://canary:8080/v1/stream
```

eva (infra): immediate mitigations:
- revert kernel-selector rollout on canaries (fast)
- ensure streaming path sets MSG_MORE for intermediate chunks (fast)
- patch validate to ignore optional ephemeral metadata (medium)
- tokenizer pool reuse across validation (medium)
- KV-prefetch for tiny batches (long)

ops-bot: Rolling back feature flag kernel-selector on canary hosts (canary-1..3). Started at 09:40. Status: in-progress.

yuri (perf): local MSG_MORE test: forcing MSG_MORE on intermediate grpc writes cut syscalls ~60% and p95 ~2x better on repro host. Patch looks safe but needs unit tests for framing.

ops-bot: Rollback completed on canary hosts. Health checks OK.

clair (eng-runtime): can confirm canary p95 back down to ~58ms after rollback. Holding full rollout until fixes landed.

ben (eng-ml): I'll open a PR to only include stable fields in the metadata hash (model_id, arch, quant_profile) and add a unit test that simulates extraneous optional fields.

yuri (perf): I'll add a perf gate job that runs the short_stream wrk scenario and fails CI if p95 increases >20% for short requests. Also will baseline writev counts.

eva (infra): I'll file an infra task to add MSG_MORE guard and a test that verifies coalescing behavior under streaming.

clair (eng-runtime): action items summary:
- rollback done (ops)
- PR: stable-hash for validate_variant (ben)
- PR: MSG_MORE in streaming path + tests (eva)
- Perf CI job for short-stream + p95 guard (yuri)
- Longer-term: KV-prefetch prototype + tokenizer-pool durability (team)

ben (eng-ml): tagging this for a follow-up postmortem; i'll link the PRs when ready.

clair (eng-runtime): thanks all. Posting a short note to #release-war-room and blocking the rollout.
